name: zilliz
description: Work with Zilliz Cloud and Milvus vector databases using the zilliz-cli.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Zilliz Cloud and Milvus using an agent
interface.longDescription: Use natural language to work with Zilliz Cloud and Milvus through the zilliz-cli. The plugin discovers available capabilities from the configured endpoint and credentials, and supports data operations as well as cloud-management workflows when available.
defaultPrompt: Verify my Zilliz data-plane context and list the collections I can access.
Describe a collection and tell me whether it is loaded and indexed.
Help me create, populate, and search a vector collection.
